test_title: PYST 48: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '5'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf6e065ff67029f9631a8d67eda7b86525b3d0b97744d44e79aa4566d153e897.png]
solution:
Explanation:

The logic followed here is: 

If two dice have the same two face values in the given image, then the third number is opposite to each other.

In the given figure, **3** and 6 are common.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e4018019c8180cc561085095d33222fd8e6f32da17785b683695b6089f65114.png] 

So, the number opposite to 5 is 2.

Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.
